Campuan Ridge Walk From Ubud

You can walk from ubud along the beautiful Campuan Ridge Walk to our village. This takes around 30 minutes. The walk begin at Ibah Resort; walk down the hill at front of Ibah Resort and follow the path around to the right before the temple.
